HeroCards.Name: Hero Cards
HeroCards.Label: Hero Card Settings
HeroCards.Hint: Customise how Hero Cards behave, including whether natural 1s and 20s can be modified and how played cards are displayed.

DiceRolling.Name: Dice Rolling
DiceRolling.Label: Dice Rolling Settings
DiceRolling.Hint: Control how natural 1s and 20s are highlighted in chat, how critical saving throws against damage are handled, whether a natural 1 or 20 on initiative decides who goes last or first, and whether one decides a check or a Roll-Off.

RollRequests.Name: Roll Requests
RollRequests.Label: Roll Request Settings
RollRequests.Hint: Configure roll request behaviour, including DC visibility, roll display options, pop-up prompts, and automatic death save requests.

WorldScripts.Name: Gameplay Enhancements
WorldScripts.Label: Gameplay Enhancements
WorldScripts.Hint: Optional quality-of-life improvements for tokens, character sheets, chat cards, and activity windows. Enable only the features you want to use.

BloodiedTint.Name: Bloodied Token Tint
BloodiedTint.Hint: Automaticaly Highlights Bloodied creatures with a red tint and matching token ring colours, making them easier to spot during play.

FadeUnprepared.Name: Fade Unprepared Spells
FadeUnprepared.Hint: Dim unprepared spells on character sheets to help players quickly identify available options.

ChatButtonLabels.Name: Chat Button Labels
ChatButtonLabels.Hint: Fixes the small attack and damage buttons from dnd 6.0 update, adds words making them much easier to see and use.

OneTabActivities.Name: One-Tab Activities
OneTabActivities.Hint: Combine activity details into a single expanded view for faster editing and content creation.

RarityColours.Name: Item Rarity Colours
RarityColours.Hint: Colour-code items by rarity using familiar RPG-style colours, helping you identify valuable items more quickly.

LockNaturals.Name: Natural 1s and 20s lock Hero Cards
LockNaturals.Hint: Prevent Hero Cards from being played on natural 1s and natural 20s. Disable this setting to allow Advantage and Inspiration to affect those rolls. Natural 1s are always final, and can't be rerolled by Lucky, Indomitable, or Relentless.

MarkNaturals.Name: Ring natural 1s and 20s
MarkNaturals.Hint: Clearly marks natural 20s in gold and natural 1s in red across chat, including attacks, checks, saves, spell and feature card rolls, and roll request results.

NaturalSaves.Name: Natural 1s and 20s on saves against damage
NaturalSaves.Hint: Natural 20 on a saving throw against a spell's or feature's damage means no damage is taken. A natural 1 deals the maximum possible damage instead, treating every damage die as though it rolled its highest value (for example, 36 from 6d6), and ignoring any resistances or immunities. The Apply tray is automatically populated with these results, but the GM remains free to adjust them before applying damage.

NaturalInitiative.Name: Natural 1s and 20s on initiative
NaturalInitiative.Hint: A natural 20 on an initiative roll puts that creature first in the initiative order, above any higher total. A natural 1 puts it last, below any lower total. Each keeps the initiative it rolled, which still orders several natural 20s, or several natural 1s, among themselves. Turn it off to order everyone by their totals alone.

NaturalChecks.Name: Natural 1s and 20s on checks
NaturalChecks.Hint: A natural 20 on an ability check, skill check or tool check made against a DC always succeeds, and a natural 1 always fails, whatever the total. It counts on roll request cards, where a plain d20 is judged the same way, and on any check D&D 5e rolls against a DC. Turn it off to judge every check by its total alone.

NaturalRollOff.Name: Natural 1s and 20s in a Roll-Off
NaturalRollOff.Hint: In a Roll-Off between two d20 rolls, a natural 20 wins outright, against any total but another natural 20, and a natural 1 loses to anything but another natural 1. Two natural 20s, or two natural 1s, are decided by their totals. Turn it off for the higher total to win every time.

ShowPlayedCards.Name: Show Played Cards on Screen
ShowPlayedCards.Hint: Briefly display Hero Card artwork when a card is played, creating a more cinematic experience for everyone at the table.

ShowDCDefault.Name: Show the DC to players by default
ShowDCDefault.Hint: Decides whether players can see the DC by default when you create a roll request. You can override it for any request. Hiding the DC removes it from the chat card.

DefaultDC.Name: DC by default
DefaultDC.Hint: The DC each roll starts with when you open the request window. Leave it blank for none, so you set a DC only when you want one, there or later from the card.

TeamScoring.Name: Team Challenge scoring by default
TeamScoring.Hint: How a Team Challenge's rolls are scored when you open the request window. You can change it for any request.

AttachRolls.Name: Attach Rolls to Request Cards
AttachRolls.Hint: Keep related rolls neatly grouped within their request card instead of creating separate chat messages.

PopupPlayers.Name: Pop Up Roll Requests for Players
PopupPlayers.Hint: Open roll requests automatically for players, allowing them to respond with a single click.

PopupGM.Name: Pop Up Roll Requests for the GM
PopupGM.Hint: Automatically open a roll request window for the GM when NPCs or unowned actors need to roll.

DeathSavePrompt.Name: Automatic Death Save Requests
DeathSavePrompt.Hint: Automatically prompt dying characters to make death saves at the start of their turn, helping combat run more smoothly.

WelcomeCards.Name: Welcome and What's New Cards
WelcomeCards.Hint: Whisper the GMs a welcome card the first time the module runs in a world, and a short note of what's new after an update that adds features.

Welcome.Heading: Welcome to Sogrom's Table Tools
Welcome.Intro: Hero Cards, roll requests and gameplay enhancements for D&D 5e. Where to find things:

Place.Cards: Give out the Hero Cards: drag {cards} from this card onto each character who should have them. It's also in the Items (Sogrom's Table Tools) compendium.
Place.Play: Playing a card: players click the Hero Card button under a roll in chat, or play one from the character sheet.
Place.Requests: Asking for rolls: the tankard {tankard} in the chat controls, under the chat log, opens the request window. Click it here to try it.

Welcome.WhatsNewHeading: What's new in Sogrom's Table Tools {version}

New.DiceSoNice: Request cards wait for Dice So Nice's dice to land before showing a roll's result.
New.Versus: Team vs Team keeps the NPCs' rolls hidden from players until you click Show NPC rolls on the card.
New.DefaultDC: DCs in the request window start blank. Set your own starting DC with DC by default, under Roll Requests.
New.Cards: This card: a welcome for new worlds, and a short note like it when an update adds features.
New.BlindRoll: Blind GM Roll is a third Roll Visibility in the request window: only you see the results.
New.ShownDC: A public Standard Roll with Show DC to Players ticked shows players who passed straight away.
New.NaturalInitiative: A natural 20 on initiative goes first in the initiative order and a natural 1 goes last, whatever their totals. Turn it off with Natural 1s and 20s on initiative, under Dice Rolling.
New.NaturalChecks: A natural 20 on a check made against a DC always succeeds and a natural 1 always fails, whatever the total. Turn it off with Natural 1s and 20s on checks, under Dice Rolling.
New.NaturalRollOff: In a Roll-Off, a natural 20 wins outright and a natural 1 loses, whatever the totals. Turn it off with Natural 1s and 20s in a Roll-Off, under Dice Rolling.

Standard.Label: Standard Roll
Standard.Hint: Each actor rolls once, against a DC if you set one.

Team.Label: Team Challenge
Team.Hint: Everyone rolls, and the team gets one result: averaged, or scored by who succeeds.

Challenge.Label: Skill Challenge
Challenge.Hint: Each actor faces three rolls in turn, and needs enough of them to succeed.

RollOff.Label: Roll-Off
RollOff.Hint: Two actors roll against each other, and the higher total wins.

Versus.Label: Team vs Team
Versus.Hint: Two teams are averaged like a Team Challenge, to one decimal place, and the higher average wins.

Divine.Label: Divine Intervention
Divine.Hint: One actor picks a run of numbers, then must roll one of them on a d100.

Subtitle.Divine: {count} numbers in a row on a d100

Average.Label: Average of the rolls
Average.Hint: The rolls are averaged, rounded down, against the DC. Each natural 1 removes the highest roll, and each natural 20 the lowest.

Half.Label: Half must succeed
Half.Hint: The group check from the Player's Handbook. If at least half the team meets the DC, the whole team succeeds.

Leader.Label: Leader, helped by the rest
Leader.Hint: The roll with the highest modifier counts, +1 for each other success and −1 for each other failure.

Weakest.Label: Weakest link
Weakest.Hint: The roll with the lowest modifier counts, +1 for each other success. Other failures don't count against it.

Note.LeaderTooltip: The highest modifier, so this roll counts for the team.
Note.WeakestTooltip: The lowest modifier, so this roll counts for the team.
Note.HelpedTooltip: Succeeded, adding 1 to the team's roll.
Note.HinderedTooltip: Failed, taking 1 from the team's roll.
Note.IgnoredTooltip: Failed. Other failures don't count against the weakest link.

Challenge.DoneTooltip: Finished. The GM will show how it went.

Result.Uncounted: Not counted: a changed DC decided the challenge before this roll. {result}
